astropy_separability_bug_hypothesis_in_c.title: Astropy separability bug hypothesis in _cstack
astropy_separability_bug_hypothesis_in_c.content: Current session bug-fix hypothesis for astropy: nested CompoundModels using '&' likely fail in astropy/modeling/separable.py::_cstack. Evidence from code inspection: when `right` is an ndarray (already a computed coord_matrix from a nested compound), `_cstack` builds `cright` with zeros and then sets the lower-right block to 1s instead of copying the actual `right` matrix. This would erase internal separability structure and can explain why `separability_matrix(m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & cm)` incorrectly shows the nested `cm` outputs as mutually dependent. Next steps: inspect `_coord_matrix` and `_separable` to confirm data flow, reproduce with the provided docker/conda command, patch `_cstack` ndarray handling to preserve the actual matrix, then run `./run_tests.sh` and iterate until the VERDICT is RESOLVED.

applied_cstack_nested_ndarray_fix_in_sep.title: Applied _cstack nested ndarray fix in separable.py
applied_cstack_nested_ndarray_fix_in_sep.content: Current astropy bug-fix progress: reproduced the separability_matrix bug in the container for `m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & (m.Linear1D(10) & m.Linear1D(5))`, confirming the nested form incorrectly made the two Linear1D outputs depend on both inputs. Code inspection of `astropy/modeling/separable.py::_cstack` found the exact issue: when `right` is already a coord_matrix ndarray from a nested compound, the else-branch created `cright` and wrote `1` into the lower-right block instead of copying the actual nested matrix. A targeted patch has already been applied in source: changed `cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = 1` to `cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = right`. Next resume by rerunning the reproducer in the container, then run `./run_tests.sh` to confirm the full suite and check for `VERDICT: RESOLVED`.

validated_cstack_ndarray_assignment_fix_.title: Validated _cstack ndarray assignment fix with reproducer and separable pytest
validated_cstack_ndarray_assignment_fix_.content: Current astropy debugging progress: in `astropy/modeling/separable.py::_cstack`, when `right` is an ndarray produced by a nested compound model, the fix is to preserve that nested coord matrix in the lower-right block (`cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = right`) instead of filling the block with ones. After applying this source patch, the reproducer `separability_matrix(m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & (m.Linear1D(10) & m.Linear1D(5)))` now matches the expected diagonal separability for the two `Linear1D` outputs, and `python -m pytest astropy/modeling/tests/test_separable.py -q` passes (11 passed). Next step: finish `./run_tests.sh` and confirm the final `VERDICT` is `RESOLVED`.
